label: Conecsa face access
info: Access control on a face recognition device with two factors: a badge (or PIN) presented at the reader wired to the "badge" input, and the badge holder's face recognized within WINDOW_S seconds of it (the detection node polls every second, so a person who stays in frame keeps the face factor fresh). Only both together pulse GPIO pin 29 for 3 s to release the door strike; a face alone, or a badge alone, opens nothing. The inject node stands in for the reader: replace it with your reader's node (mqtt in, serial in, http in, ...) emitting msg.topic "badge" and the badge id as msg.payload. Edit AUTHORIZED (person -> badge id), MIN_CONFIDENCE and WINDOW_S in the function node. Direct mode (inside the device's Flow container); set Hub + Device to drive a device through a hub instead. Face recognition has no liveness check: a printed photo can be recognized as the person, which is why the badge is required.

name: badge + face?
